svg.title: Toolkit, as a core sample
svg.desc: The stack drawn as geological strata, surface to bedrock: SHIP (Next.js, React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Streamlit, Panel, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel); MAP (GeoPandas, MapLibre GL, Leaflet, Earth Engine, hot-spot statistics); MODEL (scikit-learn, gradient boosting, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LSTM, BirdNET, fairness tests); DATA (Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, pandas, Jupyter, Plotly, Power BI); AUTOMATE (GitHub Actions, scheduled pipelines, pytest, Docker, reproducible research).

g.text: CORE SAMPLE · THE STACK, SURFACE TO BEDROCK
and say what it can't tell you
